FIGURE III-13
POPULATION COMPARISON
Westmoreland Resources most probable production (Scenario 1) vs. their high level (Scenario 2) with low Participation Rate (LFPR-1) and other significant Crow Coal Development (AF-2)
Figure III-14 illustrates the benefit of an increased Crow labor force participation rate on the Crow employment levels. It shows that after 1986, potential Crow employment could increase at a faster rate than for non-Crows. However, the difference in employment impacts between the two scenarios is not substantial for either ethnic group.
Figure III-15 illustrates the effect of a higher Crow participation rate on population. As before, if the Crow population trend curve remains constant, the assumption of other significant Crow coal development (AF-2) results in Crow population exceeding the non-Crow population.
